name: MonarchAiModeSwitcher
title: AiModeSwitcher
wrapsNative: Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) and controlSize(_:), a description Text, AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
summary: Switches how the assistant works (Ask, Edit, Agent by default) with a segmented control and shows what the selected mode may change.
whenToUse: When an assistant has 2 to 5 modes with different permissions or behaviour, for example in a prompt toolbar to set the mode of the next messages.
whenNotToUse: To choose a model or a writing style use the model or tone picker (see ai-tone-picker). For more than five modes or long names use a Picker with the menu style.
api: MonarchAiModeSwitcher.init(selection: Binding<String>, modes: [MonarchAiMode] = MonarchAiMode.defaults, size: MonarchAiModeSwitcherSize = .sm, showsDescription: Bool = true, label: String? = nil)
MonarchAiMode.init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, isIconOnly: Bool = false, isDisabled: Bool = false)

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the selected mode. A disabled or unknown id is never written.

options.name: modes
options.description: The modes, 2 to 5: each with an id, a label, an optional description, an optional symbol for an icon-only segment, and a disabled flag.

options.name: size
options.description: sm: the small control size, for a prompt toolbar. md: the regular control size.

options.name: showsDescription
options.description: Whether the selected mode's description is shown under the control. Turn it off when it is shown elsewhere.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the choice, "Mode".

states.name: selected
states.description: The system segmented control marks the selected segment; its description is shown underneath.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With the standard disabled(_:) modifier the control is dimmed and the description uses the disabled text role.

states.name: mode disabled
states.description: The segment is dimmed where the system supports it, and selecting it does not change the selection.

states.name: no description
states.description: When no mode has a description, or showsDescription is false, there is no description line.

appearance: The system segmented control, tinted by the app's accent. The description is caption text in the muted text role. No status colours: a mode is a setting, not a status. High contrast follows the system control.
platformNotes: The web builds on Monarch's SegmentedControl; iOS uses the system segmented Picker. UISegmentedControl shows a symbol or text in a segment, not both, so a symbol appears only on icon-only modes. iOS ships built-in Ask, Edit and Agent modes with descriptions; the web has no defaults. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The control is the system segmented Picker named by label ("Mode"); VoiceOver reads each segment and the selected one.
The selected mode's description is the control's hint; the visible line is not read twice.
When the selection changes and a description is shown, the new description is announced.
An icon-only segment is read as the mode's label.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no mode leaves no segment selected and shows an empty description line.
A mode with an empty description shows an empty line, so the layout does not jump.
Long descriptions wrap; long labels are truncated by the system control, so keep them to one word.

examples.title: With descriptions
examples.template:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection: $mode,
    modes: [
        MonarchAiMode(id: {{modes.0.id}}, label: {{modes.0.label}}, description: {{modes.0.description}}),
        MonarchAiMode(id: {{modes.1.id}}, label: {{modes.1.label}}, description: {{modes.1.description}}),
        MonarchAiMode(id: {{modes.2.id}}, label: {{modes.2.label}}, description: {{modes.2.description}}),
    ]
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection: $mode,
    modes: [
        MonarchAiMode(id: "ask", label: "Ask", description: "Answers questions. Changes nothing."),
        MonarchAiMode(id: "edit", label: "Edit", description: "Proposes edits you review before they apply."),
        MonarchAiMode(id: "agent", label: "Agent", description: "Works through steps and uses tools. Asks before anything risky."),
    ]
)

examples.title: Own modes, without the description
examples.code:
MonarchAiModeSwitcher(
    selection: $mode,
    modes: [
        MonarchAiMode(id: "research", label: "Research", description: "Reads sources and cites them."),
        MonarchAiMode(id: "write", label: "Write", description: "Drafts text for you to edit."),
    ],
    size: .md,
    showsDescription: false
)
